launch_notes: Operator launches run-loop.sh manually from the repo working directory. No launchd/systemd service. Process is not automatically restarted by the OS.
restart_notes: Manual restart — operator restarts as soon as crash is observed by re-running the invocation above.
rollback_notes: Restore run-loop.sh from its original location in the tracked repository tree. Canonical source is _src/run-loop.sh at HEAD.
